items.text: Ferry terminal now contains a power‑grid‑required loot room, adding new high‑tier loot for players who power it.
Gate opening direction has been reversed, and gates now snap‑place more reliably.
Gate collision bounds have been updated, altering how close you can stand to a closed gate.
Debris objects now use wood protection instead of stone, making them easier to destroy with explosives.
Honey bandage is now craftable from the primitive and hardcore tech trees, providing a new medical option.
Placeholder crafting costs for animal fencing items have been adjusted to more sensible values.
Holiday wreaths (Halloween and Easter) now deploy correctly, with fixed pickup behavior and deploy‑guide sound.
Arrows shot from bows now correctly disappear for all players, removing lingering arrow meshes.
Fences now have proper collision, preventing players and objects from clipping through them.
Gates now correctly detect and respond to player interaction, fixing cases where they would stay stuck or fail to open.

2026-09-08.summary:
### Loot & Monuments
- Ferry terminal now contains a power‑grid‑required loot room, adding new high‑tier loot for players who power it.

### Building & Defenses
- Gate opening direction has been reversed, and gates now snap‑place more reliably.
- Gate collision bounds have been updated, altering how close you can stand to a closed gate.
- Debris objects now use wood protection instead of stone, making them easier to destroy with explosives.

### Items & Crafting
- Honey bandage is now craftable from the primitive and hardcore tech trees, providing a new medical option.
- Placeholder crafting costs for animal fencing items have been adjusted to more sensible values.

### Seasonal Content
- Holiday wreaths (Halloween and Easter) now deploy correctly, with fixed pickup behavior and deploy‑guide sound.

### Visual & Bug Fixes
- Arrows shot from bows now correctly disappear for all players, removing lingering arrow meshes.

### Gameplay & Mechanics
- Fences now have proper collision, preventing players and objects from clipping through them.
- Gates now correctly detect and respond to player interaction, fixing cases where they would stay stuck or fail to open.

items.text: Cows now have health tied to mood; unhappy cows die and health bar reflects condition.
Calf spawning fixed so newborn calves no longer get stuck behind walls and can escape pens.
Holosight rail visibility adjusted per weapon and 8x scope, handmade sight, and holosight attachments refreshed.
Holstered weapons repositioned to sit closer to chest armor for better alignment.
Placement guide rotations fixed, improving accuracy when rotating structures during building.
Train tunnel layouts are now randomized, changing navigation routes and loot placement in underground networks.
Fixed a save bug that unintentionally altered the Most Recently Used (MRU) list, preventing unexpected inventory changes on logout.

2026-09-07.summary:
### Animals & Livestock
- Cows now have health tied to mood; unhappy cows die and health bar reflects condition.
- Calf spawning fixed so newborn calves no longer get stuck behind walls and can escape pens.

### Weapons & Attachments
- Holosight rail visibility adjusted per weapon and 8x scope, handmade sight, and holosight attachments refreshed.
- Holstered weapons repositioned to sit closer to chest armor for better alignment.

### Building & UI
- Placement guide rotations fixed, improving accuracy when rotating structures during building.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Train tunnel layouts are now randomized, changing navigation routes and loot placement in underground networks.

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed a save bug that unintentionally altered the Most Recently Used (MRU) list, preventing unexpected inventory changes on logout.

items.text: Item pickup notices now display correctly without layout glitches.
Players will no longer be kicked for non‑critical errors on background threads.
Floating bandages bug fixed – bandages now rest on the ground as intended.
Prevent unintended player rank downgrades in the editor that previously failed to kick the player, ensuring proper enforcement of permission changes.

2026-09-06.summary:
### UI & Quality of Life
- Item pickup notices now display correctly without layout glitches.

### Stability
- Players will no longer be kicked for non‑critical errors on background threads.

### Items & Equipment
- Floating bandages bug fixed – bandages now rest on the ground as intended.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Prevent unintended player rank downgrades in the editor that previously failed to kick the player, ensuring proper enforcement of permission changes.
